reviews.comment: She was an awesome professor! Cared a lot about her students and accommodated to your needs if you couldn't make it to class! Super funny and makes lectures interesting!
Short two-week summer class. What is expected of you is very clear, and it is obvious that she cares about you succeeding. As long as you give effort, it should be an easy A.

reviews.comment: Super sweet professor. Very caring, helpful, and understanding. Easy class that required a decent amount of work but was rewarded well if you put in the effort.

reviews.comment: Paige is a really great teacher. Only 3 projects and a few participation assignments for this class so be sure to turn everything in. As long as you try it is an easy A.

Paige was literally incredible. Her class consisted of 3 video projects, a few group attendance assignments, and quite a few guest speaker lectures. Attendance is only mandatory on activity days but her class was never one that I wanted to miss because of how much I loved it. She cares about her students and she is all around just so cool!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Paige Jennings was a great professor! Her class consisted of 4 speeches, a few peer/self review and outline assignments, and a multiple-choice final exam. Her lectures were very easy to follow along with. I also thought that interactive aspects of her lectures were actually fun and liked how they often allowed you to learn more about your peers!

Class consisted of four speeches and some other assignments, plus an easy final. An online speech class was interesting, but it worked somehow. Take her feedback from each speech, complete assignments on time, and just ask any questions you have in class. Paige Jennings is very nice!
If you do your work and turn it in on time, there shouldnt be an issue getting an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria
